instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Outdoors on a wooden deck with a metal railing, with a river and green trees in the background. On the far left, the man in the grey t-shirt (R3) stands in profile facing right, raising his hands. In the center-left background, the woman in the pink cardigan and grey hijab (R1) faces right. In the center-right background, the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) faces left. On the right, the woman in the beige hoodie (R4) stands in profile facing left, smiling. In the foreground, the man in the grey t-shirt (R3) and the woman in the beige hoodie (R4) high-five with raised palms. Behind them, the woman in the pink cardigan (R1) and the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) also high-five. Soft, warm natural daylight illuminates the scene.
